apps.title: Halloween Art Color
apps.summary:
Jack-o’-lanterns flicker, witches soar across the moon, and ghosts peek from haunted windows—bring the magic of Halloween night to life, one color at a time.
Halloween Art Color combines a relaxing paint by number game with the charm of a Halloween-themed adult coloring book. Follow the numbers, tap to fill each area, and watch uncolored outlines become vibrant Halloween pictures.
🖌️ Easy to Play, Satisfying to Complete
No drawing experience needed. Choose a picture and let the numbers guide you.
- Follow the numbers: match each color to its numbered areas.
- Tap to fill: bring color to each space with simple taps.
- Skip the brushwork: no sketching, color mixing, or careful tracing required.
- Watch the transformation: see every detail come together as you complete your picture.
🎃 Color Up Your Halloween World
From cute and playful to dark and mysterious, explore coloring pages filled with seasonal charm.
- Pumpkin glow: jack-o’-lanterns, autumn pumpkin fields, and festive displays.
- Witchy magic: witches, spell books, and bubbling potions.
- Spooky encounters: ghosts, vampires, skeletons, and mischievous monsters.
- Mysterious creatures: black cats, bats, ravens, and magical companions.
- Moonlit scenes: haunted houses, Gothic castles, graveyards, and shadowy forests.
- Trick-or-treat fun: costumes, candy, happy Halloween parties, and colorful decorations.
Pick a playful ghost for a cheerful coloring moment, or explore the intricate details of a mysterious castle. Every picture reveals a different side of Halloween.
🕯️ A Little Spooky. A Lot of Relaxation.
Take a quiet coloring break in a world of Halloween magic. Enjoy a few taps between daily tasks or settle into the details of a favorite scene.
If you enjoy casual games, Gothic illustrations, or cozy seasonal art, this color by number experience offers a simple way to unwind. Find your own moment of zen in the gentle rhythm of filling each space, and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing your picture come together.
Download Halloween Art Color, light the jack-o’-lanterns, and awaken the magic beyond the haunted windows—one color at a time!

apps.title: Goods Sorter
apps.summary:
The shelves are full of mixed-up groceries. Can you put everything in the right place?

Goods Sorter is a colourful sorting puzzle where you move products between shelves and bring identical items together. Look carefully at each arrangement, use the available spaces wisely, and clear the goods one group at a time.

Simple drag controls make each puzzle easy to begin, while more crowded shelf layouts require thoughtful decisions. Moving the wrong item can limit your options, so consider what each space will open before making your next move.

If you become stuck, helpful tools can reveal a move, pause the timer, or rearrange the remaining items.

Features:

• Drag and rearrange products across the shelves
• Match identical goods to remove them
• Solve a variety of shelf arrangements
• Plan moves around the available spaces
• Use hint, freeze, and shuffle tools
• Enjoy bright, grocery-themed visuals
• Play at your own pace in quick or longer sessions

Find the matches, organize the shelves, and complete each sorting challenge in Goods Sorter.

A. Yes! An intuitive UI and step-by-step tutorial make this quick card game easy to learn. Start with recommended decks, then experiment with custom card deckbuilding as you learn the game. With auto-play and one-handed controls, you can enjoy deep turn-based strategy even during short breaks.

Recommended for: Players who enjoy card deckbuilding, fans looking for a casual roguelike with deep turn-based strategy, and anyone looking for an easy-to-pick-up quick card game and card RPG!

Download Card of Demon Slayer now and conquer dark fantasy dungeons with your custom deck!

Build your own custom deck and conquer dark dungeons in this card deckbuilding roguelike RPG! Choose your strategy at every fork in the road and unleash powerful ultimate skills. Start your journey today in a quick card game that combines casual roguelike gameplay with deep turn-based strategy!

Q. What kind of mobile game is Card of Demon Slayer?
A. Card of Demon Slayer is a card deckbuilding roguelike RPG where you build your own deck and take on challenging dungeons. Navigate branching paths and make tactical choices in turn-based battles. Combine cards strategically to activate powerful ultimate skills and defeat tough bosses in this card RPG.

Q. How does it stand out from other roguelike games?
A. Unleash powerful ultimate skills based on your card strategy. The right card combination can turn the tide of battle in an instant. At every step, choose between risk and reward as you explore branching dungeon routes. If long, time-consuming games feel like too much of a commitment, this casual roguelike offers deep turn-based strategy in short play sessions. Card of Demon Slayer is a quick card game designed to be easy to pick up without requiring hours of grinding.

Q. What kind of characters appear in the game?
A. Meet cute SD animal characters in a dark fantasy setting! Join the fox hero and recruit unique companions to build your team in this card RPG. Each companion has distinct abilities, opening up different turn-based strategies when combined with your card deck.

Q. What are the core gameplay features and dungeon strategies?
• Custom Deckbuilding: Collect and combine hundreds of cards to build a deck that fits your own card deckbuilding strategy.
• Strategic Ultimate Skills: Create powerful card synergies and unleash ultimate skills that can turn the tide of battle.
• Branching Dungeon Paths: Navigate roguelike dungeons filled with unexpected events, treasure, and challenging encounters.
• Fox Hero & Companions: Collect companions with unique abilities to strengthen your team. Finding companions that work well together is a key part of the strategy in this card RPG.
• Auto-Play Support: Let auto-battle handle repetitive fights so you can focus on turn-based strategy during critical boss battles. Play this quick card game with simple controls, or take full manual control when needed.

• Vertical One-Handed Play: Enjoy vertical, one-handed play wherever you are.

A. Yes! An intuitive UI and step-by-step tutorial make this quick card game easy to learn. Start with recommended decks, then experiment with custom card deckbuilding as you learn the game. With auto-play and one-handed controls, you can enjoy deep turn-based strategy even during short breaks.

Recommended for: Players who enjoy card deckbuilding, fans looking for a casual roguelike with deep turn-based strategy, and anyone looking for an easy-to-pick-up quick card game and card RPG!

Download Card of Demon Slayer now and conquer dark fantasy dungeons with your custom deck!

apps.title: Color Tales Cozy Coloring Book

Welcome to Color Tales, your personal storybook sanctuary of relaxation, warmth, and artistic wonder! Step into a peaceful world where charming characters, adorable woodland friends, and heartwarming stories await your gentle touch.

Designed specifically for adults seeking a soothing way to de-stress, embrace quiet me-time, and enjoy low-pressure creativity, Color Tales transforms digital coloring into a magical daily ritual.

Whether you are sipping your morning coffee or curling up in bed for a cozy evening, our app brings you a warm sanctuary filled with artistic elegance and emotional comfort.

apps.title: Frolf Fest: Arcade Disc Golf
apps.summary:
Throw. Compete. Collect.

Frolf Fest is arcade disc golf in your pocket. Fun for both disc golf experts and those new to the sport.

Throw:

Pick your line, time your tempo, and watch the disc turn and fade down the fairway. Thread through tight tree gaps, throw long bombs, finesse touchy approaches, and drain long range putts. Test yourself across a variety of demanding courses, with real wind and weather mechanics.

Compete:

Play duel matches against real players, challenge your friends to a round, or sharpen your skills against challenging bot rivals across a variety of game modes.

Collect:

Every disc flies differently. There are many ways to conquer the course - find your own game. Earn unique and exclusive disc molds, trails, finishes, stamps, bags, and avatar customizations as you play through the game.

Share:

Share highlights and wild shots with friends! See the best long-range hole-outs, unfortunate tree kicks, and incredible aces from the community.

Play:

7+ challenging, hand authored courses across a variety of unique biomes. Multiple game modes, from casual solo rounds and fun competitions with friends, to frantic tournaments and tough ranked duels against real rivals.

Throw far. Compete hard. Collect it all.

- Throw - authentic disc flight with turn, fade, and impactful wind and weather across varying terrain and times of day.

- Compete - real opponent duels in stroke, skins, and stableford formats, friend challenges, leaderboards, and multi-round tournaments.

- Collect - unique and exclusive discs, trails, finishes, stamps, bags, customizations.

- Share - replay and save memorable shots to share with friends.

- Arcade fun - the satisfaction of realistic disc golf flight paired with fast-paced arcade gameplay.

- Good gaming - controller / gamepad support, offline play, and cloud saves available.

- Frolf Fest is a game that respects you - no ads for anyone, ever. The game contains no subscriptions. If you choose, you can join the Pro Club with a single, one-time purchase to unlock all Frolf Fest has to offer and support game development.

Welcome to PawBlock! A block puzzle game where naughty cats and colorful boxes come together in a playful hide-and-seek challenge. apps.title: MapTap.gg
apps.summary:
MapTap is a daily geography game. Every day you get five places tied to real events from that exact date, and the game is to find each one on a 3D globe. Tap where you think it is. The closer you land, the higher you score. Then you read what actually happened there: a shipwreck, an invention that failed twice before it worked, a border that moved overnight, someone nobody has heard of who changed something you use every day.

It takes about 2 minutes to play. Tomorrow there are five more, and five more the day after that. Keep a streak alive, see how your score sits against everyone else who played that day, or just against players near you. When 2 minutes is not enough, there is a lot more globe. Practice maps run from plain drills to journeys you retrace one stop at a time: Magellan's expedition, Darwin's voyage on the Beagle, Nellie Bly's race around the world, Ibn Battuta's travels. Find the Flag is a daily of its own. Gauntlet is a timed run at a set of locations everybody gets on the same day. Frontier is a survival run where one bad guess ends it. Versus puts you head to head with another player over five locations, with a rating that follows you around. Flashcards drill a map until it sticks.

There are hundreds of achievements to discover. You can build maps for other players, and play other players' maps!

MapTap plays in 12 languages. MapTap+ is an optional subscription that adds sharper satellite detail on the globe, the full run of practice maps, private groups to play alongside friends, the last 90 days of games you missed, drill sets you build yourself, and the curated Best of MapTap collection.

The daily game is free, and there are no ads in it anywhere, for anyone, ever.

apps.title: Boom Crush: 3D Blast Fun
apps.summary:
Welcome to Boom Crush, a cheerful casual game with physics puzzle action. Aim a cannon at unstable towers and watch blocks, crates, and cans move, bounce, and fall in a 3D arena.

Choose a level, inspect the stack, set your cannon angle, and shoot at the weak point. A careful cannon shot can crush a support, trigger a blast, and send the tower into a chain reaction.

Physics Puzzle Challenges

Every physics puzzle has a different layout. Light blocks slide easily, while heavy pieces hold the stack. A low cannon shot may crush the base; a higher cannon shot may reach a protected block. Watch how the first blast changes the physics puzzle before choosing your next cannon move.

Cannon, Crush, and Blast Action

Tap to aim, adjust the cannon, and shoot. A direct cannon shot may smash one block, while a planned cannon launch can create a wider blast. Look for gaps and weak supports.

Objects tip, bounce, break, and crush into one another. A small blast can shift a stack, while a side blast can push a block toward another target. A central blast may open a path for a second crush. Every smash changes the scene. Watch the first smash, plan the next smash, and use a final smash when the stack is ready. One crush can lead to another crush, while a careful blast can prepare the next blast.

One smash can move a block; a second smash can start a blast. Watch the smash before the next smash and adjust your shot.

Colorful Stacks and Simple Controls

Boom Crush uses familiar objects in casual game levels. One physics puzzle may use boxes and crates; another physics puzzle combines cans, jars, and rubber ducks. Use the cannon to move a key block, then let gravity continue the crush. A careful smash can remove one support, while a wider blast can clear a row.

The controls are easy for casual players, but each physics puzzle rewards observation. Replay a level to test another cannon position, compare a low shot with a high shot, and find a cleaner route. An angle change can create a new blast path. If the first smash leaves a block standing, adjust the cannon and try again.

Relaxing Casual Games

Play a quick round or continue through more casual games. Watch the tower lean as pieces smash, slide, and settle. Every crush matters, and each cannon shot can change the result.

For another physics puzzle, adjust the cannon angle. A short cannon shot may crush one block, while a longer cannon launch can start a blast. Let the first crush settle, then choose a second blast or smash. The right cannon move can connect the next crush and smash.

In a physics puzzle, a careful blast can shift the base before a second blast reaches the upper stack. One crush can open a path, one smash can move a block, and another smash can finish the layout. Study the target, plan the blast, and choose the next cannon action.

Can you solve every physics puzzle, manage your cannon shots, and use each blast wisely? Aim at the weak block, start the crush, and enjoy this casual game.

apps.summary:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

apps.title: Narco Empire
apps.summary:
Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

apps.title: Jam Bus:Sandfall
apps.summary:
Jam Bus: Sandfall brings a fresh twist to bus jam, color puzzle, and traffic escape gameplay.
Colorful sand is stacked in layers, and every bus has its own color and direction. Tap the right bus, collect the matching sand, and clear the board step by step. Sounds simple at first, but every move can change the whole puzzle.
Plan carefully before you tap. Some buses may block each other. Some paths may cross. Some sand colors can only be cleared after the lower layers are gone. To win, you need to observe the board, choose the right order, and keep every bus moving without a crash.
How to play
• Tap a bus to move it along its route
• Match each bus with the same color sand
• Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
• Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
• Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
• Relaxing color-matching gameplay
• Clever bus parking jam puzzles
• Satisfying sand-clearing effects
• Increasingly tricky routes and layers
• Clean visuals and smooth puzzle flow
• Great for quick breaks and brain training
Every level is a small logic challenge. A bus may look ready to move, but its route might block another vehicle. A color may be visible, but the sand below it must be cleared first. Think ahead, follow the arrows, and find the perfect order to clear the whole sandfall.
If you enjoy bus games, parking jam puzzles, color sort games, traffic escape challenges, or relaxing logic games, Jam Bus: Sandfall gives you a colorful new puzzle to solve.
Start with one bus, clear one color, and let the sand fall into place.

apps.summary:
Real animals. Strange splices. Stranger battles.

Chimera TCG is a strategic collectible card game where you splice real animals into creatures that have never existed, collect them, and build a deck for battle.

COLLECT THE ANIMAL KINGDOM

Start with 54 real animal Base cards, each with nature-documentary field notes, an environment, a size, and a trait. Great White Shark. Golden Eagle. Honey Badger. The building blocks of a much stranger collection.

SPLICE SOMETHING NEW

Combine two Base cards in the Splicer to create a Chimera. Every pairing is valid. Compatible animals are easier to Splice, while unlikely combinations can produce rarer results at greater risk.

Add a third Base card to attempt a Mythic Chimera. Use Stabilizers to improve your odds, or stack three Stabilizers for a guaranteed success.

DISCOVER WHAT NO ONE HAS

When someone successfully Splices a brand-new combination, its name, artwork, and field notes are created on the spot. Discover it first and you are credited in the shared catalog as its Origin Splicer.

BATTLE ACROSS THREE LANES

Build a 12-card deck and battle across Land, Water, and Air in a six-turn match. Spend energy to play cards face-down, then watch both sides reveal simultaneously. Win two of the three lanes to take the match.

Build around card abilities, trait interactions, and home-lane advantages. Fight adaptive rivals, climb from Novice toward Master, compete on the weekly wins leaderboard, or challenge friends in live head-to-head battles.

GROW YOUR COLLECTION

Earn XP by battling, Splicing, and opening packs. Spend Coins to level up your favorite cards, and Recycle spare duplicates into more Coins.

Send Field Expeditions that return with free cards. Complete daily quests, progress through a new Battle Pass each month, and earn rewards as your collection grows.

CHASE VARIANTS AND COMPLETE LINEAGES

Collect special Variants with alternate artwork and Battle bonuses, including limited-time seasonal styles such as Steampunk. Complete animal Lineages to earn Silver and Gold Leaf Variants, fill your Trophy Case, and unlock collection rewards.

FREE TO PLAY

Build your collection, Splice Chimeras, and battle without spending money. Optional in-app purchases are available. An internet connection is required.

In-app purchases and randomized items: Some optional card packs contain randomized cards. Exact odds and selection rules are shown in the app before purchase and at chimeratcg.app/odds.html. Catalog-based odds may change as players discover new Chimeras. Gems cannot be exchanged for real money.
